articles.title: My CD Just Matured and Rates Have Dropped. Should I Roll It Into Bonds Instead?
articles.snippet: A maturing CD in a falling rate environment is one of the most common fixed income crossroads investors face. You locked in a rate, the CD delivered, and now the renewal rate is meaningfully lower than what you earned. The question of whether to roll into another CD or shift into bonds is worth examining carefully because the answer depends on your timeline, your income needs, and where rates are likely to go next. articles.title: Australia knock India out to reach Women's T20 World Cup semis
articles.snippet: India were knocked out of the Women's T20 World Cup after Australia’s Ellyse Perry and Ashleigh Gardner struck half-centuries to secure a six-wicket win at Lord's on Sunday. Australia maintained their flawless record in the group stage, winning all five matches to finish top and advance to the semifinals, chasing down India’s target of 171 with an over to spare.
